# Extract the 'Structural type' column to identify towers
tower_rows = df[df['Structural type'].str.contains('Tower', case=False, na=False)]

# Sort by the 'Height\nmetres / ft' to find the first to reach new heights
# Extract the numeric height in metres (first part before '/')
tower_rows['height_metres'] = tower_rows['Height\nmetres / ft'].str.split('/').str[0].str.strip().astype(float)

# Find the row with the smallest height_metres (first to reach new heights)
earliest_tower = tower_rows.loc[tower_rows['height_metres'].idxmin()]

# Get the country of that tower
answer = earliest_tower['Country']
